feature_request: Build a single-page calculator app: one Flask app, plain HTML UI served at the root route /. The page contains two number inputs, a way to pick one of the four basic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide), a Calculate button, and a labeled result area. Submitting the form computes the result server-side and re-renders the page with the result. Division by zero shows an error message instead of crashing. Keep it minimal: no auth, no database, no JS frameworks.
